title: List all physical designators of a flattened project
summary: Compiles the focused project when needed and lists the physical and logical designator and source sheet of every component instance in the flattened document, optionally writing a text report.
phrasings: list every component instance in a multichannel design
get physical designators of all components
compile a project only if needed
read the flattened document of a project

commands.name: GetAllComponents
commands.description: List the physical designators of the compiled project
commands.params: Out=<file or folder> (optional)|Open=true (optional)|Max=<designators listed in the result, default 50>
